decisions.reason: Reusable agricultural harvest crates have steady, recurring demand from growers and fit the firm's core plastic returnable packaging range, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
The foldable large container had a dedicated page in both years, which suggests it is a strategically promoted product in a growing segment of reusable logistics.
Stackable plastic crates are a staple product with broad applications and low cost to maintain in the portfolio.
Rackable pallets are a core logistics product with stable industrial demand, so the firm would likely continue offering it.
Spill-retention pallets serve a regulation-driven niche, but the drop from a dedicated page to a mention suggests lower priority, so the drop risk is somewhat higher.
The pallet with load retainers is a specialized variant that was downgraded on the website, yet it likely shares tooling with the core pallet line and so remains cheap to keep.
